“Explicit” multiplication and division have the same weight and are calculated from left to right, but “implicit” multiplication have a higher weight. At least, this is how I learned it in algebra.

If it was written 2/2*(2+2), there would be no ambiguity… In computer science, you never omit the multiplication sign (*), that is why PEMDAS is working no problem.
